title: 第636章 门后面有人不止一个第635章 这写的啥
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 西行的路比预想中好走。
钱多多换了一块新测灵石，指针稳稳指着西北偏西，连抖都不抖。
他低头看了三次，终于没忍住："这玩意儿以前跳得跟抽风似的，今天怎么这么稳？"
兰濯池跟在后面记数据：
"因为下面那个在替我们开路。他拆得越深，残片暴露程度就越高，测灵石能捕捉到的信号就越强。"
他抬了一下眼皮，"他拆了多久，我们就省了多少找路的功夫。"
"那他最好多拆一会儿。"钱多多把测灵石收起来，"反正累的不是我们。"
林枝意走在前头，脚步比之前稳了一些。
紫电挂在腰间，随着步伐轻轻叩击。
走了约两个时辰，前方出现一道极窄的峡谷。
两侧岩壁高耸入云，中间只留一条不到一丈宽的通道，风从深处灌出来，带着潮气和极淡的焦糊味。
钱多多在谷口蹲下来按了一下地面，又站起来看了看两侧岩壁：
"有人来过，不超过两天。碎石被翻动过，边角还没被风磨圆。走得很快，没有停留。"
嘎嘎跑回来蹲在钱多多脚边，抽了抽鼻子，然后朝峡谷深处叫了一声。
林枝意走过去蹲下，伸手摸了一下地面那道痕迹。
指尖触到碎石表面时，一丝极淡的灵力残留顺着指腹跳了一下，像一根被拨动的琴弦。
云逸抱着陨星走到前面探了探，退了回来：
"里面有东西，活的。"
钱多多又掏出测灵石，亮了一下又暗了，像被什么东西按住了。
"不是人。是阵法在运转，像一扇半开的门。"
柳轻舞走到云逸旁边，流光横在身前，素玉浮在肩侧。闭眼感应了片刻：
"门后面有人。不止一个。"
话音未落，峡谷深处传来一阵急促的脚步声。
片刻后，三个人从拐角冲出来，跑在最前面的穿着灰扑扑的法衣，胸口绣着一枚不认识的宗门徽记，脸上带着一道没干透的血痕。
他跑出来时一头撞在嘎嘎身上。
嘎嘎被撞得往后滑了半步，银灰色的毛炸了一下，但没有动，四只爪子稳稳钉在地面上，硬生生把他挡停了。
那人踉跄着退了两步，惊恐地抬头。
一只银灰色的毛球蹲在面前，用一种"你撞到我了"的目光看着他；
毛球后面站着六个年纪不大的修士，穿着干净，神情平静，像在散步时遇到了一个跑得太急的人。
他身后的两个同伴也追了上来，三个人同时停下脚步，喘着粗气。
灰袍修士先开口，声音又哑又急："快走！后面有东西在追我们！"
林枝意看了一眼他们跑来的方向。
拐角后面什么也没有，没有追兵脚步声，没有灵力波动。
"什么东西在追你们？"
"不知道！我们在地下挖到一样东西！黑色的，拳头大小，边缘有金色纹路，我刚碰到它，整个地面就开始塌——"
他说到一半忽然停下来，目光落在林枝意腰间的储物袋上，瞳孔一缩，"那、那个残片——你们也有？"
钱多多在后面轻声接了一句："他说的跟我们刚挖出来的好像是同一种东西。"
灰袍修士声音压得更低了："你们那一块……有没有字？"
content_en:
The journey westward was easier than expected.
Qian Duoduo changed to a new spirit stone, and the pointer pointed steadily to the northwest without even shaking.
He looked down three times and finally couldn't hold it back: "This thing used to dance like a convulsion. Why is it so stable today?"
Lan Zhuochi followed behind and took down the data:
"Because the one below is clearing the way for us. The deeper he digs, the higher the degree of exposure of the fragments, and the stronger the signal that the spirit-detecting stone can capture."
He raised his eyelids and said, "As long as he demolishes it, we will save a lot of time in finding the way."
"Then he'd better take it apart for a while." Qian Duoduo put away the spiritual stone, "Anyway, it's not us who are tired."
Lin Zhiyi walked in front, his steps steadier than before.
The purple lightning was hung on his waist, tapping gently with his steps.
After walking for about two hours, a very narrow canyon appeared in front of us.
The rock walls on both sides towered into the clouds, leaving only a channel less than a foot wide in the middle. The wind poured out from the depths, bringing moisture and a very faint smell of burning.
Qian Duoduo squatted down at the entrance of the valley and pressed the ground, then stood up and looked at the rock walls on both sides:
"Someone has been here, no more than two days ago. The gravel has been turned over, and the corners have not been rounded by the wind. They walked very fast and did not stop."
Gaga ran back and squatted at Qian Duoduo's feet, sniffed, and then shouted deep into the canyon.
Lin Zhiyi walked over and squatted down, reaching out and touching the mark on the ground.
When the fingertips touched the surface of the gravel, a faint trace of spiritual power jumped along the fingertips, like a plucked string.
Yun Yi hugged the meteor and walked forward to explore it, then stepped back:
"There's something in there, something alive."
Qian Duoduo took out the spirit-testing stone again. It lit up and then dimmed, as if it was being held down by something.
"It's not a person. It's the formation moving, like a half-open door."
Liu Qingwu walked to Yun Yi's side, with the stream of light lying in front of her and the plain jade floating on her shoulders. I closed my eyes and sensed for a moment:
"There's someone behind the door. More than one."
Before he finished speaking, there was a rush of footsteps deep in the canyon.
A moment later, three people rushed out from the corner. The one running at the front was wearing a dusty cassock, with an unknown sect emblem embroidered on his chest, and a trace of blood on his face.
When he ran out, he bumped into Gaga.
Gaga was knocked back half a step, and his silver-gray fur exploded, but he did not move. His four claws were firmly nailed to the ground, stopping him abruptly.
The man staggered back two steps and looked up in horror.
A silver-gray fur ball squatted in front of him, looking at him with a "you hit me" look;
Behind the hair ball stood six young monks, cleanly dressed and with calm expressions, as if they had met someone who was running too fast while taking a walk.
The two companions behind him also caught up, and the three of them stopped at the same time, breathing heavily.
The gray-robed monk spoke first, his voice hoarse and urgent: "Let's go! Something is chasing us from behind!"
Lin Zhiyi glanced at the direction they were running from.
There was nothing behind the corner, no footsteps of pursuers, no fluctuations in spiritual power.
"What's chasing you?"
"I don't know! We dug something underground! It was black, the size of a fist, with golden lines on the edge. As soon as I touched it, the whole ground started to collapse——"
He suddenly stopped mid-sentence, his eyes fell on the storage bag on Lin Zhiyi's waist, and his pupils shrank, "Then, that fragment - do you have it too?"
Qian Duoduo whispered from behind: "What he said seems to be the same thing as what we just dug out."
The gray-robed monk lowered his voice: "On your piece... are there any words on it?"
title_en: Chapter 636 There is more than one person behind the door Chapter 635 What does this say?
